items.problem: `Logout` has the same race as R1-1, and it existed before this diff. It acts on "the current session" after `routing` step 5 checked the session outside the transaction. When another device's `AutoLogin` commits in between, the spec does not say whether `session.end_session`(ctx) closes that newer session (skills/server-core/modules/session.md:29 and :45 do not say whether `end_session` compares the session ID). It also does not say whether the deleted login token rows are those of ctx `session_id` or of the session record
